name: Marcus Reid
bio: Twenty years in front of a closing bell. Hosts Garbatrage Now and the mid-session tape. Treats every uptick like an achievement and every dip like a personality flaw.

name: Priya Sharma
bio: Former policy wonk who made the jump to cable. Reads dot plots the way other people read novels, and can narrate a GDP release the way an auctioneer narrates a bid.

name: Tessa Nguyen
bio: Economist by training, storyteller by instinct. Writes the confidence index like a weather report for the national mood, and is rarely wrong about the forecast.

name: Omar Zayed
bio: Charts proxy statements and comp tables for a living. Has strong feelings about vesting cliffs and is not afraid to use them in a broadcast.

name: Elena Marsh
bio: Runs the desk that produces the basket, the calls, and the occasional apology letter. Believes the market rewards the patient and punishes the theatrical.

name: Dana Whitfield
bio: Responsible for the firm's long-running thesis that value hides in unglamorous places. Calm, specific, and suspicious of anyone who yells about growth.

name: Jake Sullivan
bio: Your alarm clock in a blazer. Pre-markets, futures, and the weather in commodity markets before most of you finish coffee. Never once late to the tape.

name: Claire Reyes
bio: Talks basis points like a second language and has correctly called four consecutive dot plots. Owns the yield-curve segment no one else wants.
